subject: English
stimulus: (a) Had I much money ⎯⎯. (b) He pretended as if ⎯⎯. (c) Ten years have passed since ⎯⎯. (d) Hardly had the match started ⎯⎯. (e) If you had invited her ⎯⎯.
guide_solution: Completing sentences (a) Had I much money I would buy a wonderful car. (b) He pretended as if he had known everything about the matter. (c) Ten years have passed since we met last. (d) Hardly had the match started when we started to clap our hands. (e) If you had invited her she would have joined the party.
